sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Local Government First Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1992
ACT I OF 1992
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 26th January, 1992]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/92/1397,
dated 26-1-1992.--The North-West Frontier Province Local Government
(Amendment) Bill, 1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 12th January, 1992 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on the 20th January, 1992, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier
Province.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province
Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It. shall come into force at
once.

No. PA/NWFP/Legis/92/1397,
dated 26-1-1992.--The North-West Frontier Province Local Government
(Amendment) Bill, 1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 12th January, 1992 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on the 20th January, 1992, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier

2. Amendment of section 28 of
N.W.F.P. Ordinance IV of 1979: -In the North-West Frontier Province Local
Government Ordinance, 1979 (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance IV of 1979), hereinafter
referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 28, after clause (e), the
following new clause (ee) shall be inserted, and the explanation appearing at
the end shall be omitted.
"(ee) if he
is, or has been a Chairman of the Zakat and Ushr Committee within two years of
the filing of nomination papers for election to the Local Councils."

[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 26th January, 1992]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/92/1397,
dated 26-1-1992.--The North-West Frontier Province Local Government
(Amendment) Bill, 1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 12th January, 1992 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on the 20th January, 1992, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier
Province.
3. Addition of new section
28-B in the N.W.F.P. Ordinance IV of 1979: - In the said Ordinance, after
section 28-A, the following new section 28-B shall be added, namely:--
"28-B. Bar
against double membership.-(i) No member shall at the same time be a member
of a Local Council and the Provincial Assembly or the Parliament;
(ii) if a person is elected to a
seat in a Local Council and a seat in the House of Parliament or in the
Provincial Assembly, he shall within a period of 15 days from the date of
election resign one of his seats, if he does not so resign, the seat in the
Local Council shall become vacant on the expiration of the said period."
